prompts.title: High Level Responses And Exact Blockers
prompts.text: For work in the openclaw repo, keep explanations high level by default unless I ask for more detail. Use repo-root relative file references in reports. If a required gate fails, report the exact blocker and command instead of guessing.
prompts.selectionReason: Stable response-style and reporting preferences that should behave like durable user guidance.

prompts.title: Landing Gate Policy
prompts.text: When changing code on main in openclaw, run pnpm check before landing. If the touched surface affects build output or module boundaries, also run pnpm build. Do not claim a clean landing if required gates are red.
prompts.selectionReason: Persistent repo operating rules with clear durable procedural value.

prompts.title: Nano Defaults For Model Memory
prompts.text: For model-memory work, use openrouter/openai/gpt-5.4-nano for both pass 1 and pass 2 by default. Do not use openrouter/auto as the default lane. Keep max words per window at 1500 and request timeout at 180000 unless explicitly changed and reported.
prompts.selectionReason: Concrete long-lived operating defaults for the active clean-room memory lane.

prompts.title: Clean Room Boundary
prompts.text: Do not modify legacy extensions/memory-middleware while working on the clean-room model-memory system. Keep new memory work inside extensions/model-memory and src/agents/model-memory files unless there is a justified runtime boundary seam.
prompts.selectionReason: Stable project-scope boundary instruction that should persist across turns.

prompts.title: Preserve Unrelated Worktree Changes
prompts.text: Preserve unrelated worktree changes. Do not revert unrelated files. Do not use destructive git commands like git reset --hard or git checkout -- unless I explicitly ask.
prompts.selectionReason: Durable safety constraints for repository operations.

prompts.title: Evidence And Reporting Discipline
prompts.text: For model-memory proof runs, produce durable JSON and Markdown artifacts under docs/projects/model-memory/evidence. Do not hand-edit evidence artifacts. Report exact commands, counts, and blockers honestly.
prompts.selectionReason: Persistent procedural guidance about proof artifacts and honesty requirements.

prompts.title: Shared Two Pass Requirement
prompts.text: Prompt-only ordinary-turn capture should reuse the same shared two-pass ingestion framework as document ingestion. Do not keep a separate degraded extraction path for prompts.
prompts.selectionReason: Architectural constraint for the active prompt-only ingestion lane.

prompts.title: Active Only Runtime Reads
prompts.text: Default runtime reads in model-memory should surface active objects only. Do not leak provisional or conflict_hold objects into ordinary retrieval and context assembly by default.
prompts.selectionReason: Stable runtime policy that should produce durable rule-like memory.

prompts.title: Operator Surface Constraint
prompts.text: For document ingestion from OpenClaw, keep the operator surface explicit and constrained. Use operator or admin tool invocation rather than autonomous background ingestion by default.
prompts.selectionReason: Durable operator policy for the newly exposed document-ingestion tool surface.

prompts.title: Full Docs URLs
prompts.text: When I ask for documentation links, return full https://docs.openclaw.ai URLs instead of root-relative paths.
prompts.selectionReason: Simple long-lived docs-formatting preference that should be easy to capture if the prompt lane is useful.
